quote: North Sea Dated crude oil prices tumbled by 32%, dropping from a high of $136/bbl in early October to $93/bbl at the time of writing, as a sustained recovery in Gulf exports eased market tightness.
Diesel prices also fell by 11% in Europe over the same period but, at close to $180/bbl, remained 77% above pre-war levels.
Global oil supplies surged by 2.3 mb/d to 105.4 mb/d in October, lifting output by an extraordinary 5.3 mb/d since August.
Despite continued attacks on tankers, Gulf oil exports, excluding Oman, reached 18.4 mb/d last month, 26% below pre-war levels.
The recent increase was led by crude, with flows rising to 15 mb/d, equivalent to 82% of pre-war levels in October.
